ten.remaining_race_arithmetic.mechanism: Maximum and minimum achievable ranking points by the settlement date for each contender, given 52-week drop-offs and remaining events. Finals-qualification contracts use the calendar-year Race instead (no drop-offs): Race places 1-7 qualify and the eighth place is reserved for the highest-ranked current-year Grand Slam singles champion in Race places 8-20, else Race place 8; withdrawal after qualifying does not change settlement.
ten.remaining_race_arithmetic.measurement: Season-end rank (KXATP1RANK, KXWTA1RANK, KXATPT5RANK): P_end = P_now (52-week points) - points dropping off between the as-of date and the last list published before the snapshot + points earned in remaining counting events; per-event maximum from the official points table (ATP Finals: 200 per round-robin win, +400 semifinal win, +500 final win, 1500 undefeated), minimum 0; P(rank 1) or P(top 5) = share of 20,000 simulated season completions (match probabilities from ten.surface_rating, entry from ten.major_participation_hazard) in which the player holds that rank, with P=0 when the gap exceeds the maximum swing. Finals qualification (KXATPFINALSQUAL, KXWTAFINALSQUAL): simulate the calendar-year Race (no drop-offs) to the final pre-Finals Race list; qualified set Q = Race places 1-7 plus one eighth place = the highest-Race-ranked current-year Grand Slam singles champion (from ten.career_major_count_state) in Race places 8-20 who is not already in places 1-7, else Race place 8 (rule verified for ATP and WTA; if two such champions, the higher-ranked takes the place). P(Yes) = share of simulations with the player in Q. No reduction for withdrawal after qualifying (contract: 'If player qualifies but does not compete, the market resolves to Yes'); Race places 9-10 are alternates and a promoted alternate is NOT counted as qualified unless a Kalshi precedent says otherwise (sr_finals_qual_contracts). As-of: after each Monday Race/ranking publication.

ten.career_major_count_state.measurement: Count of singles major titles per player, each with tournament and final date; compare to the contract's target at the as-of date and flag if the count differs from the contract assumption. Also emit, for the current calendar year, the set of Grand Slam singles champions (ATP and WTA separately) as of each major final, which feeds the Finals-qualification eighth-place exemption in ten.remaining_race_arithmetic. As-of: after each major final.
